hook: In mice, sleep restores neuron autophagy that waking suppresses, and sleep-timed stimulation cut amyloid.
summary: In mouse cortex, long wakefulness reduced neuronal autophagy and sleep quickly restored it. Closed-loop optogenetic stimulation of lysosomal acidification only during sleep reduced amyloid pathology in 5xFAD mice, while wake-timed stimulation worsened it. The results are from mice and a single Alzheimer model, and some mechanisms are described as putative.
title: Sleep promotes neuronal autophagy for intracellular clearance
